text:
jen: Heads-up — Aster VPC private deploy scheduled for Tue 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC (maintenance lane). The window is 45m. Planning to push runtime v2.3.4 + config tweaks. Who's on the deploy and who can own rollback?

mike: I'll drive the deploy. I'll be primary for rollout and smoke.

sara: I'll be on standby for infra/route checks and can rollback if needed. What's the rollback signal?

jen: Rollback signal = >10% 5m error rate OR >200ms p95 for 2 consecutive probes. Rollback plan is to pin to v2.3.3 and switch routing weight back to baseline.

lee: Add me for DB-migrations check — we have a small migration. I'll gate it with a --dry-run first.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window starts in 48 hours. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/aster-deploy

mike: Smoke checklist I'm planning:
```
- curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' https://aster.private.redwood/api/health
- run loadtest: tools/replay --target aster --duration 30s --rate 50
- check dashboards: infra > aster-service > latency/errors
- verify KV cache warmup: redis-cli --raw ping
```

sara: FYI I'll flip the canary weight 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m observation windows.

dalia: Can we get a quick code-review ping on the runtime config change? I left one comment on #pr-2584 about a missing env var.

jen: PR acked, dalia. mike — please confirm that the env var is set for Aster in the VPC secrets store before cutover.

mike: Confirmed: secret updated. I'll also post step-by-step in thread at T-15m.

lee: Migration dry-run done locally, no schema drift.

sara: I'll be the rollback runner if we see the signal. Have prepared the rollback commands:
```
- infractl deploy set-version --service aster --version v2.3.3
- infractl routes set-weight --service aster --weight 100 --version v2.3.3
- notify: #oncall, #cust-success
```

jen: Thanks all. If anything changes ping here. tagging @mike @sara @lee :eyes:

ops-bot: Deploy window started (2026-04-07T02:00:00Z). Good luck! :rocket:
